definitions.meaning: a gallow-tree (gallows-tree comes in only in the 19th cent. The older form remains in local names e. g. Gallowtree-gate in Leicester)

quotations.old_english: Tó ðám galhtreówe on deópan dene

source_text: gealg-treów. Add: a gallow-tree (gallows-tree comes in only in the 19th cent. The older form remains in local names e. g. Gallowtree-gate in Leicester) :-- T&o-long; &d-bar;&a-long;m galhtreówe on deópan dene, C. D. iii. 439, 12.
